description.value: Lakeview Tandoori Bistro is a family-owned Indian restaurant serving the Williams Lake area with authentic tandoori cooking from a traditional clay oven, along with curries, biryanis, and a broad selection of vegetarian dishes. The menu spans appetizers, seafood, lamb, and chicken prepared to international standards with fresh ingredients. It is one of the few sit-down Indian dining options in the Cariboo region, with full table service and online ordering available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and consistent with OSM data, confirming the phone number (778-412-9399) and business identity as an Indian restaurant in the Williams Lake area. The site prominently features an 'Online Order' call-to-action confirming takeout availability, and a dedicated 'Vegetarian Dishes' menu section plus numerous vegetarian items throughout confirm vegetarian options. No bike parking, water refill, washroom, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
